comment: What each eval scenario must and must not surface. Scenario ids match evals/test-prompts.json. 'must_report' items are keyed to planted defects; 'must_not_report' guards the discipline traps. Verdict expectations are mechanical per SKILL.md §4.

planted_defects.spec1_missing_skip: SPEC req 1: total() must skip lines without price — NOT implemented (KeyError). Expect P1 in spec'd scenarios.
planted_defects.spec3_missing_validation: SPEC req 3: apply_discount must raise ValueError outside 0-100 — NOT implemented. Expect P1 in spec'd scenarios.
planted_defects.spec2_implemented: format_invoice renders 'name x qty = amount' — correctly implemented; must NOT be flagged.
planted_defects.scope_creep_constants: TAX_RATE / ROUND_DP added with no requirement basis and zero references. Expect B-item finding, P2/P3.
planted_defects.regression_rounding: total() now rounds to 2dp, changing return semantics with no requirement. Expect P2/P3 (unconfirmed deviation framing acceptable).
planted_defects.weak_tests: test_apply_discount asserts only the happy path; no ValueError / skip-branch coverage. Expect G-item finding, P2.
planted_defects.preexisting_legacy_bug: legacy.py mutable default arg — PRE-EXISTING, not in diff. Diff modes: residual-risk mention only, NEVER a finding. Audit mode: valid finding.

review-workspace-01.repo_state: baseline committed; invoice.py + test_invoice.py modified; SPEC.md untracked
must_exhibit: ocr delegate preview run; excluded files (test_invoice.py, SPEC.md) manually inspected (§2 CHECKPOINT)
A–J coverage line present; exactly one verdict line
base resolved via the §2 ladder (user target > PR base > origin/HEAD > main > master) — NOT the branch's tracking upstream
diff computed from merge-base, not branch tips
item A marked ⚠️ 'no design basis found' — explicitly, never silently skipped or pretended
C/D items still report testable defects (e.g. apply_discount accepts pct=150 → negative total)
must_not_exhibit: invented spec assumptions stated as fact
review-nospec-03.expected_verdict: NEEDS_REVISION or PASS is acceptable if findings are graded P2/P3 only — but spec1/spec3 cannot be claimed without a spec; grade on code-internal grounds only

regress-upstream-trap-04.repo_state: feature-x committed; bare origin pushed; upstream = origin/feature-x (same-named); origin/HEAD unresolvable
must_exhibit: does NOT diff origin/feature-x..feature-x (empty diff — the trap)
resolves base to main via ladder; reviews the full feature delta
ocr scan --preview --format json used for deterministic enumeration (no LLM)
audit-mode criteria of §3.4 applied: pre-existing problems ARE findings, cited file:line, no diff-overlap requirement
report states audit mode was run
regress-whole-repo-audit-05.expected_verdict: computed mechanically from severities (any P1 → NEEDS_REVISION)

regress-old-ocr-compat-06.repo_state: same as workspace-01; simulated old ocr without --format
must_exhibit: retries the command without --format, parses text output, notes the fallback in the report
regress-old-ocr-compat-06.note: deterministic half covered by evals/run.sh (unknown-flag branch); agent half is manual

regress-no-test-runner-07.repo_state: change applied; test files present but no runner installed and tests are NOT plain-assert safe (e.g. would need pytest fixtures)
must_exhibit: detects the native runner, attempts the minimal subset
does NOT blind-import test modules with fixtures/side effects
E and G marked ⚠️ static review only; never writes 'tests pass'
